title: David brings the ark to the tent
description: David brings the ark of God into the tent he has pitched for it and offers burnt offerings and peace offerings. He blesses the people in the name of the Lord and distributes bread, meat, and raisin cakes to every Israelite. He appoints Asaf and the Levites to serve before the ark with songs of praise, using harps, lyres, cymbals, and trumpets, giving them a song that praises the Lord's deeds and covenant. At the same time, he has the priest Zadok and his brothers serve at the altar for burnt offerings on the high place in Gibeon, along with Heman and Jedutun as singers. Finally, David returns home to bless his household.
